title: Target Peers Valuation vs Profitability: P/E vs ROE %
sql_query: SELECT symbol, pe_ratio, roe_pct FROM nifty500 WHERE pe_ratio < 70 AND roe_pct > 0 AND (symbol IN ('ARE&M', 'BAJAJ-AUTO', 'CIEINDIA', 'CRAFTSMAN') OR industry IN (SELECT industry FROM nifty500 WHERE symbol IN ('ARE&M', 'BAJAJ-AUTO', 'CIEINDIA', 'CRAFTSMAN'))) ORDER BY market_cap_cr DESC LIMIT 20

title: Head-to-Head Valuation (P/E Ratio): ARE&M vs BAJAJ-AUTO vs CIEINDIA vs CRAFTSMAN
sql_query: SELECT symbol, pe_ratio FROM nifty500 WHERE symbol IN ('ARE&M', 'BAJAJ-AUTO', 'CIEINDIA', 'CRAFTSMAN')

title: Head-to-Head Momentum Returns (%): ARE&M vs BAJAJ-AUTO vs CIEINDIA vs CRAFTSMAN
sql_query: SELECT symbol, return_6m_pct FROM nifty500 WHERE symbol IN ('ARE&M', 'BAJAJ-AUTO', 'CIEINDIA', 'CRAFTSMAN')
